verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents its own search operators, and its AI assistant can 'search your entire email history.' Coverage of full history is limited, though: by default only the last 90 days are imported, and community reports say free-plan search excludes mail older than 90 days. missing for 10: evidence of search speed, ranked/relevance-ordered results, a detailed list of operators and filters, guaranteed full-history search on all plans, and independent hands-on corroboration of search precision.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history
